why: Draws a HELD stock with the same hollow outline as a lost one, which erases the only difference between them and leaves four identical shapes whatever the count. The fill is an SVG attribute on `currentColor` rather than a CSS background precisely so it survives forced colours, where a background-filled mark and a hollow one become identical -- the failure the #230 mockups measured and the reason `hud.css.test.ts` refuses `background` in any `hud-stock-` rule.
killedBy: hud: identity-shaped stocks, the `marks` arm (issue #230) paints in currentColor with no literal colour and no background
